svg.text: 20 paths x 5 stages = 100 designs. Tiers are local to each path. Read each row left to right.
Entry rules: Neutral T3 → elemental T1. Two parent elemental T3 items → fusion T1.
Full IDs: SW_{ARCHETYPE}_{PATH}_T{1..5}. Image paths and recipes are in Metadata/assets.json and Metadata/recipes.json.
